title: Playboy Magazine November 1963 Jimmy Hoffa Interview Covers Detached Reading
conditionDescription: Front and back covers completely detached but included. Interior intact. Reading copy.
descriptionText:
Playboy Magazine, November 1963 issue, with the Jimmy Hoffa interview. Cover price 75 cents.

Condition: Poor / reading copy, priced accordingly. Both the front cover and the back cover are completely detached from the magazine - they are included but separated from the binding. Wear, toning and creasing consistent with age. Interior pages intact. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review all photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
